mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is your daily dish. It is a scorching 91 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail, feeling like a very sweaty 95 under clear skies, so try not to melt out there. On the civic front, the city is offering cash-back rebates if you install rain barrels or high-efficiency toilets. In local police news, an officer had to let a motorcycle flee at high speed after the rider blew through red lights without a license plate. Finally, Culver's is closing soon at 10:00 PM, so run out right now for today's delicious flavor, Chocolate Covered Strawberry!
